author: Feras754
quote: I expected much more from a game that has been hyped for years. GTA VI had the potential to be something truly groundbreaking, but instead, it feels like a disappointing experience that fails to live up to the expectations. The hype surrounding this game was simply too much, and the final result does not justify it. Being a GTA game is not enough to make it great. Rockstar should have delivered something far more ambitious and innovative.
